sources.summary: Junyang Lin, the former technical lead of Alibaba's Qwen, walked through the model family in a talk "towards a generalist model / agent," then expanded it in an essay. We read both for practitioners: Qwen3 hybrid thinking modes and dynamic thinking budgets, where the merge fell short, the shift from reasoning thinking to agentic thinking, why agentic RL infrastructure is harder, and where reward hacking bites. The post Qwen’s Former Lead on What Hybrid Thinking Got Wrong — and Why He Now Backs Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
